name: nod
description: Um lugar onde agentes preparam decisões e uma pessoa decide.

scripts.dev:setup: npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:migrate:test && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/motor/build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run fence:domain && npm run fence:migrations && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:conformidade && npm run test:concurrency && npm run db:test:limpar
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.domain.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.motor.json --noEmit
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.uat:gestao: vitest run --project integration tests/integration/gestao-agentes.test.ts && vitest run --project concurrency tests/concurrency/gestao-agentes-http.test.ts && vitest run --project unit tests/unit/use-cases/duplicar-agente.test.ts
scripts.uat:regressao: vitest run --project concurrency tests/concurrency/produto-v1.test.ts tests/concurrency/e2e-catcher.test.ts tests/concurrency/revogacao-entre-enfileirar-e-despachar.test.ts && vitest run --project integration tests/integration/marketplace.test.ts tests/integration/composio-rls.test.ts
scripts.desktop:mac: node scripts/desktop/release-preflight.mjs && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.desktop:windows: npm run desktop:build -- --windows && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder-windows.yml

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: if command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then mise exec -- npx lint-staged; else npx lint-staged; fi

author: nod
